Satellite name PSAT2 (PSAT-2, ParkinsonSat-2, PSAT 2, USNA-15)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 1.5U
Status Reentry 2023-02-15. Was operational (Public website last visited on 2019-09-24)
Launched 2019-06-25
NORAD ID 44354
Deployer P-POD (Poly-Picosatellite Orbital Deployer)
Launcher Falcon Heavy
Organisation US Naval Academy Satellite Lab
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Headquarters US
Partners Aerospace Corporation, Office of Naval Research of the US Navy
Oneliner

Amateur radio payload for APRS communication.
Description

A 1.5U CubeSat for APRS communication. Planning to use 145.825MHz APRS and 435.350MHz FM for downlinks and 145.825MHz for APRS uplink plus a 28.120MHz PSK31 uplink.
